text:
QUOTE: "Without it, the diff would treat every existing reaction on the post that is not in the one-item payload as stale and delete it. A single `reaction_added` event would wipe the other reactions on that post."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that `skipSync: true` prevents the single incoming reaction from being treated as the full set, which would otherwise delete all other reactions on the post.
